name: ANYmal-D

source.task: Isaac Lab core/velocity, ANYmal-D flat, trained with Newton + MuJoCo Warp
source.robot: newton-assets anybotics_anymal_d (BSD-3-Clause, ANYbotics AG), converted by tools/make_anymal_d.py
source.actuator_net: Isaac Lab Nucleus ActuatorNets/ANYbotics/anydrive_3_lstm_jit.pt (ANYmal-C ANYdrive 3.0 net, used for ANYmal-D in Isaac Lab)

joint_order_note: policy order == MJCF order == Newton model order: depth-first by leg (LF, LH, RF, RH), each HAA, HFE, KFE. Verified in simulation: type-major (all HAA, all HFE, all KFE) falls within 2-3 s, and so does leg order LF,RF,LH,RH with type-major; depth-first LF,RF,LH,RH stays up but does not walk well.

control.note: 4 physics steps of 5 ms per policy step; the actuator network runs at EVERY physics step (its LSTM state advances at 200 Hz)

terms.name: base_lin_vel
terms.note: velocity of the trunk in its own frame (MuJoCo qvel[0:3] is world frame: rotate by R^T)

terms.name: base_ang_vel
terms.note: MuJoCo free-joint qvel[3:6] is already in the body frame

terms.name: velocity_commands
terms.note: vx, vy, wz (m/s, m/s, rad/s); trained on [-1,1] each, heading command on (stiffness 0.5, optional here)

terms.name: last_action
terms.note: the raw policy output of the previous policy step

actuator.layout: x[12,1,2] = per-joint rows; h,c [2,12,8] carried between physics steps; in_scale (2, 0.25) and out_scale (20) are inside the network

clip.rule: v = clip(qd, +-12.5); top = min(120*(1 - v/7.5), 80); bottom = max(120*(-1 - v/7.5), -80); tau = clip(net, bottom, top)

physics.note: training used robot friction 0.8 static / 0.6 dynamic times terrain 1.0; self collisions were enabled; no randomisation is needed to walk
